key_idea: Current graphs (voltage-graph duals labelled by cyclic-group elements satisfying Kirchhoff's law) generate rotation systems that yield triangular embeddings of K_n by group translation.
reason: The upper bound is a short, clean Euler-formula argument, but almost all of the proof is the lower bound, which splits into twelve residue classes. Each class needs its own infinite family of current graphs, plus handle-and-flip patching and sporadic ad hoc embeddings, so the central current-graph idea gets buried under casework that a reader cannot hold in mind or see as inevitable.
recognized: Ringel–Youngs proof of the Heawood conjecture (Map Color Theorem), via current graphs
